Specification: This module is a small test specification that exercises several core TLA+ constructs rather than modeling a distributed or fault-tolerant algorithm. It defines a bounded-sequence helper operator and an initial-state predicate that checks arithmetic, ranges, set comprehension, filtered set comprehension, existential quantification, and a conditional comparison against an expected set of sequences, with TLC Print calls used as test outputs. The behavior after initialization is trivial because Next leaves the single variable unchanged, and the module also defines a simple invariant that is always TRUE.
IfThenElse: IF BdedSeq({x}, 2) # {<<>>, <<2>>, <<2,2>>} THEN Print("Failed Test 7", TRUE) ELSE Print("Test 7 OK", TRUE)
